title: Paired item close-up, strict front (hands, boots, generic pair)
description: A pair kept together at the SAME strict-front angle as on the sheet, cropped close for detail.

body.subject: Reference the attached strict-front A-pose character sheet. Render BOTH {{pair}} of the same character as a labelled pair, close-up framing, including any gloves, rings, armour, straps or buckles exactly as on the sheet.
body.action: Left item on the left of the frame, right item on the right, both at the SAME strict-front angle ({{front_cue}}).
body.camera: STRICT FRONT VIEW: no three-quarter outer view, no side angle, no hero angle; identical orientation for both items.
body.style: White background, neutral flat lighting; same colour, material and wear as the sheet; sharp focus at 2K.
body.constraints: If the pair is asymmetric (a glove and a bracer) label which is left and which is right.

front_cue.default: palms to the camera, fingers relaxed and slightly spread
front_cue.description: hands: palms to camera; boots: toes pointing at the camera

negatives: no environment, shadow or rim lighting
